title: Pancreatic Surgical Database
summary: This data base has been set in order to gather medical and surgical information from patients who have undergone surgery for pancreatic cancer, at Institut Paoli Calmettes or Assistance Publique des Hôpitaux de Marseille, France.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient \>18 ans
* Surgery for a pancreatic cancer

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient refusal to participate in the study
